title: Variable Selector
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox HDL Support/Signal Management/Variable_Selector.md
text: Select subset of rows or columns from input, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Fill values} sets Fill values; {Number of input signals} sets the number of inputs, {Select}, {Selector mode} sets the indexing mode, {Elements} sets the selected elements, {Index mode}, {Invalid index} sets the error handling Clip and {Fill empty spaces in outputs (for logical indexing)} sets the fill in empty spaces in outputs. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: InN
ports.summary: N th input signal scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: OutN
ports.summary: N th Output signal scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Invalid index
params.values: Error handling Clip Index (default) | Clip and Warn | Generate Error

params.name: Fill empty spaces in outputs (for logical indexing)
params.values: Fill in empty spaces in outputs on (default) | off
